claims.text: Missed calls can trigger an automatic text-back within seconds
Leads reach a business through multiple channels (phone, form, message, walk-in) and most shops only automate the first
A unified inbox threads every text and email per contact so no channel gets missed

disclosure: Sourced from 2026 SMS/carrier compliance publications (A2P 10DLC registration requirement)

claims.text: Since February 2025, major U.S. carriers block unregistered A2P 10DLC business text traffic outright rather than filtering or delaying it.
Automated texts like missed-call text-backs, appointment reminders, and review requests can fail to deliver if sent from an unregistered number, with no alert to the sender.
The fix is registering the business's brand and messaging campaign so content matches the approved use case.
